text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
Great work, Trainer! To think our team 
would become this incredible...!

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
I have had the pleasure of watching you 
for a long time... and I am deeply moved!

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
Wishing you all the best in your future 
endeavors, please allow me to offer a 
little refreshment.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
"Tazuna's wonderful refreshments sent team 
morale through the roof! Everyone's 
motivation for the Aoharu Cup 
skyrocketed!"
